reviews.claim_text: The Lord tells him attention is being wasted on Iran and should go to Europe instead, because Europe is the bigger deal and they are going to try to cause a major war which will be a great war.
reviews.note: New element is the ranking: Europe explicitly named as the bigger theatre than Iran, which earlier tellings did not do.

reviews.claim_text: He sees Putin dressed all in black, stiff like a board, becoming onyx, in connection with Iran and with Russia being part of it.
reviews.note: First telling of the onyx image in the corpus.

reviews.claim_text: Putin becomes a black onyx tower with a sharp point rather than a flat top, which he compares to a sickle or an icicle and describes as looking like a weapon.
reviews.note: Fills in the shape of the image without adding an event.

reviews.claim_text: The Lord tells him there is a leak and a mole in Ukraine.
reviews.note: The earlier telling puts the mole inside the Democratic party leaking to Kyiv; this one puts the mole in Ukraine. Parked side by side rather than merged, because the location is the substance.

reviews.claim_text: He sees purple over Poland and says Poland is there because it had the better weapons, with Ukraine out in front.
reviews.note: Adds a reason for Poland's role, its weapons, and puts Ukraine in front of it.

reviews.claim_text: He confirms seeing the Canadian prime minister sending troops and men to fight.
reviews.note: First telling. Distinct from the standing watch-Carney claim, which is about the man rather than a deployment.

reviews.claim_text: Italy and all of them are drawn into a major war which he likens to the Second World War but with bigger and much nastier weapons.
reviews.note: Raises the stated scale to a second world war with heavier weapons, which is a sharper bar than the earlier great war wording.

reviews.claim_text: England tries to take its boats into the Black Sea to come against this and Turkey blocks them.
reviews.note: Repeats the blocking from earlier in the same video with nothing added.

reviews.claim_text: He says the Lord is reaffirming that America's economy will be backed by Venezuela along with the finances of Colombia and Brazil, with big trade among those powers while a cartel is in trouble.
reviews.note: Adds Colombian and Brazilian finance to the Venezuelan oil backstop, which the earlier tellings did not name.

reviews.claim_text: A major disruption involving the Mexican president, Mexico and the cartel is coming in the days ahead, with major civil unrest and people coming against the Mexican government.
reviews.note: Puts the Mexican unrest in the days ahead, which is the nearest horizon this thread has carried.

reviews.claim_text: A new cold war is breaking out around Cuba and there is a major uprising in Cuba as it tries to flex with what it has.
reviews.note: Adds a major uprising inside Cuba to the cold war framing.

reviews.claim_text: China watches while the others fight it out, and he says to pay attention to China because it is being quiet and sneaky.
reviews.note: Repeats the watch-China word from earlier in the same video.

reviews.claim_text: He repeats that a lady named Ursula is connected directly to Satanism, that the Lord called her a Satanist, and that George and other wealthy influential European leaders are with her.
reviews.note: Third telling in this video, wording shifted from bride of Satan to Satanist.

reviews.claim_text: Reading a headline that the United States has entered a deal with Venezuela covering 65 billion barrels of oil reserves, called the biggest oil deal in world history, he says this is what the Lord said and that the president is trying to stabilise the dollar.
reviews.note: The headline is news, not his word; what he adds is the stated purpose of stabilising the dollar. His this is what the Lord said is a fulfilment assertion and belongs in that table, not here.

reviews.claim_text: Comparing reserve figures read off the screen, 303 billion barrels against 209 billion and 45 billion, he says this is why the president went after Venezuela and that it holds more than Saudi Arabia and Canada.
reviews.note: Supplies the reserve arithmetic behind the ten percent drugs, ninety percent oil framing already on this claim.

reviews.claim_text: He says they will call it a golden age.
reviews.note: Bare repeat of the golden age label, with no year attached this time.

reviews.claim_text: A new oil boom will come forth with pipelines in America and in Texas, and he says to watch Texas and Oklahoma, having seen major money coming with oil.
reviews.note: Narrows the boom to Texas and Oklahoma with pipelines named, against the earlier wider list of states.

reviews.claim_text: He says the Lord showed them cyber attacks, without naming a target.
reviews.note: A bare cyber attack line with no target, scale or date. Not attached to the grid, FAA or aviation cyber claims, because nothing here identifies which one he means.

reviews.claim_text: He reads a report that Russia has warned it could strike British military targets over the United Kingdom's growing support for Ukraine.
reviews.note: Headline read off the screen; the warning is Russia's, not his.

reviews.claim_text: He says a Jason Bourne experience is coming for the Ukrainian president, that he will be here and then not, that people will wake up one morning and find him gone, and that they are going to make an example of him.
reviews.note: The Jason Bourne framing matches this thread rather than the taken-out-and-partitioned one. New element is being made an example of. Overlaps the Zelensky removal claim, recorded as a system edge rather than merged.

reviews.claim_text: He says they are going to provoke a major war by striking the Kremlin in the days ahead.
reviews.note: Adds the consequence, that the strike is meant to provoke a major war, and puts it in the days ahead.

reviews.claim_text: He says the Lord had told them the Ukrainian president would become emboldened with France and the others, and that he will become even more emboldened.
reviews.note: First telling threaded under its own claim. He frames it as an earlier word now landing, which is a fulfilment assertion and stays out of the validation table.

reviews.claim_text: He says the Ukrainian president is about to receive weapons of longer reach, from the United Kingdom and France, and that this is what they are discussing.
reviews.note: Adds the United Kingdom alongside France and moves the timing to about to receive.
